description: This file contains configuration and variable definitions for versioning and packaging in the OpenWrt project, including URL references, version info, and sed script generation.
external_files: config variables (implied, e.g., CONFIG_VERSION_NUMBER, CONFIG_VERSION_REPO, etc.)

methods.name: taint2sym
methods.description: Converts a taint string to its symbolic form based on CONFIG variables.

methods.description: Extracts the name part from a taint string.

methods.name: sed_escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters for sed substitution.
